== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
The ship prohibition changes from being aboard starships to deploying to or boarding starfighters. Both prohibit the stated access to enclosed vehicles. The early attrition clause names battles at the same site; the later clause names the opponent’s characters present and expresses the same numerical increment per character.
